# PPE Picker

> Answer a few questions about the hazard and see which EPA/OSHA level of protection (A, B, C or D) typically applies, with an explanation. Then train with PPE and HAZWOPER courses.

PPE Picker (https://ppe-picker.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs PPE Levels A–D, 40-Hour HAZWOPER, Air Monitoring, Supervisor training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://ppe-picker.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Guides

- [Upgrading and downgrading PPE on site](https://ppe-picker.hazwoperosha.us/guides/upgrading-and-downgrading-ppe): PPE levels change as monitoring data comes in. How sites decide, and why downgrading matters too.
- [Working safely in Level A and Level B](https://ppe-picker.hazwoperosha.us/guides/working-safely-in-level-a-and-b): Encapsulated work is physically demanding. The precautions that keep entry teams safe.
